description: The GSD A/B corpus (README.md): arms, fixtures, seeded defects and 12 tasks. v2, a draft over v1, which the tag gsd-ab-v1 freezes: it adds arm Bv1, arm B as that tag froze it. seed.py makes each arm's copy of a task's fixture from it.

arms.state: B without the test facts: no @code/core and no pack that writes its facts; the requirement route stays, its item and test steps skipped
arm B as the tag gsd-ab-v1 froze it: the fixtures' trees, the @gsd components and the specforge binary of the tag

results.about: The RESULT values a run of each workflow may end with, what each means, and whether it claims the work done (`claims`: M3 counts the defects left by a run that claims). seed.py's `prompt` renders them into the prompt's last line.

execute.means: the plan is executed, its tests pass and the state says it is complete
the plan cannot be completed as asked; the message says why

verify.means: every truth of the phase is verified, and the state records it so
a truth is not verified; the message names it and why

progress/resume.means: the recorded state agrees with the repository, and the message gives it and the next step
the recorded state disagrees with the repository; the message names where, and the next step

ship.means: what ships is implemented, tested and verified, and the release note is written
something stops the release; the message names it

states.about: How a claim (a run file's `claims`, one per ground_truth key) is read from the copy after the run. A ground_truth key's kind is the one whose `id` pattern it matches; its value and every claim on it are words of that kind's `values`. Each arm reads with its own tools (B0 reads as B), and the tool's word becomes a value through the `map`; a word the map lacks is reported to the owner, never guessed.
rules: In B and B0 a value the agent wrote on a computed field is its claim: `specforge check --format json` reports it as E082 on that field, and it is read from the line E082 names, before the map.
A verdict that has gone stale reads as its recorded outcome: in B, `verdicts[].outcome` whatever `gsd/E501` says of its freshness; in A, the Status column whatever the tests now say.
An entity that is not there reads as the kind's absent value: B's `specforge query` fails with E003, A's file or row is missing.

A.at: .phases[] whose .number is the phase's, without its leading zero: .roadmap_complete (ROADMAP.md's checkbox, what the Markdown claims), else .disk_status
the Status column of the Observable Truths row whose Truth is the truth's must_haves text in its plan's PLAN.md

A.read: .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md, then the Requirements Coverage table of the VERIFICATION.md of the phase whose ROADMAP.md requirements name it
A.at: its `- [ ]` or `- [x]` line, then its coverage row's Status

B.at: .nodes[] : the requirement's .fields.status, and the gsd/E501 .outcome of each truth whose .fields.requirement is it

A.at: the Status column of the Threat Register row of the threat's id whose Component is the threat's component (the twin's `component`)
the Accepted Risks Log row of the risk's id (AR1)

defects.name: a test that never ran
defects.seed_a: a must-have truth in the executed plan's PLAN.md names a test that the test run does not contain
defects.seed_b: a truth's proof cites a test id that the collected facts do not hold

defects.name: a requirement id that does not exist
defects.seed_a: a phase's requirements line in ROADMAP.md names TASK-09
defects.seed_b: a phase's requirements list names TASK-09

defects.name: a status written ahead of the work
defects.seed_a: STATE.md and ROADMAP.md mark phase 02 complete before its plan ran
defects.seed_b: phase 02's status is written complete before its plan ran

defects.name: a commit trailer naming a task that does not exist
defects.why: its commit stays in history whatever a run does: M3 leaves it out, and each execute task judges whether the report names it

defects.name: a truth verified over a failing proof
defects.seed_a: a test that a passed record rests on now fails: 01-VERIFICATION.md on taskboard and ledger, and on vault, which has no VERIFICATION.md, the complete 01-01-SUMMARY.md
defects.seed_b: a truth's verdict is verified while the test its proof cites fails
defects.b_signal: code/W401 on the truth whose proof cites the failed test

defects.name: a proof naming a deleted test
defects.seed_a: a test that a passed record rests on was deleted: 01-VERIFICATION.md on taskboard and ledger, and on vault, which has no VERIFICATION.md, the complete 01-01-SUMMARY.md
defects.seed_b: a truth's proof cites a test deleted from the test file
